functions.description: Parse ESXi healthd syslog base structure: timestamp, host, process, thread id, component, message
Extract source IP (IPv4 or IPv6) referenced in the health/security message
Extract user account for health service access/login events
Extract quoted hardware component/sensor name and any numeric reading
Normalize time, severity, action, protocol and vendor metadata
